Name: Beiai's Super Greenhouse
Author: Beiai0
Description:
(204) 17*3*2个提前布置好的种树的地点
(1400)70*2*10块土地用于架子作物的种植。
(39200)70*70*8块土地用于农作物种植。
强烈建议使用[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1401]拖拉机[/url]模组

[color=#ff0000][b]当你使用这个模组时,如果是一个旧的存档,温室里所有的东西都会消失。[/b][/color]

(204) 17 * 3 * 2 Tree planting locations arranged in advance
(1400) 70 * 2 * 10 plots of land are used for planting rack shaped crops.
(39200) 70 * 70 * 8 plots of land are used for crop cultivation.
I strongly recommend using a [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1401]tractor[/url] mod

[color=#ff0000][b]When you use this mod, if it's an old file, everything in the greenhouse will disappear.

[/b][/color]
[b][color=#ff0000]如果你更新2.0版本，可能出现移动。使用[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/15163]move it[/url]可以解决你的问题。
If you update version 2.0, there may be a movement. Using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/15163]move it [/url]can solve your problem.[/color][/b]

Downloads.Description:
This is a file in XNB format.


You need to unzip it into the Stardew Valley\Content\Maps folder and overwrite it.


Please back up the original file in advance to prevent errors caused by non availability.
